_about: Residencies extracted verbatim from 6 shared claude.ai chats made on Andrea's OTHER account (extracted 2026-09-11). Kept SEPARATE from the ~/Art residency-scout pipeline: different chats, different criteria. Facts are as stated in those chats, NOT re-verified.

A.topic: Residencies from top/emerging artists' interviews; criteria = Paris/Japan/Italy, stipend, travel covered, open to Indians, diverse. Andrea shortlisted #1, #7, #3 for her sheet; PDF 'Top 10 for emerging artists'

B.topic: Top 5 Japan, mixed media / all media, emerging; funded table + PDF

C.topic: Top 5 Italy, mixed media / all media, emerging

D.topic: New / modern residencies open to all media and all nationalities; funded table

E.topic: Top 5 Paris, mixed media / all media, emerging

F.topic: Top 5 London, mixed media / all media, emerging

residencies.name: Studio Museum in Harlem, Artist-in-Residence
residencies.provides: $50,000 stipend, private studio, culminating exhibition
residencies.eligibility: Geared to artists of African/Afro-Latinx descent; open to all nationalities but not the stated focus; no visa sponsorship
residencies.notes: Huge stipend, no travel or housing, self-fund visa

residencies.name: Banff Centre, Early Career Banff Artist in Residence
residencies.requirements: Resume, letter of intent, project proposal, portfolio (10 samples); $65 app fee
residencies.provides: Studio, private room, meal plan, faculty mentorship; standard scholarship = 100% tuition + 50% housing/meals
residencies.eligibility: Domestic and international; Canadian visitor visa needed
residencies.notes: Paid program: ~$8,832 total, ~$2,600 out of pocket after scholarship; no travel stipend

residencies.name: Palazzo Monti
residencies.requirements: Name, email, artist statement, PDF portfolio, EUR 25 app fee
residencies.provides: Private bedroom, private studio, utilities, basic supplies, on-site events
residencies.notes: No stipend or travel; artist pays travel, food, return shipping. Occasional partner prizes (ACS GBP 2,000, UK/EEA only). Also appears in chat C.

residencies.name: Kunstnarhuset Messen
residencies.provides: Studio/housing
residencies.notes: No stipend; you pay NOK 1,000/month + living and travel; fully open internationally

residencies.name: ESMoA Artist in Residence
residencies.notes: No stipend found; nomination-based rather than open call

residencies.name: RISD Studio Residency
residencies.notes: Not an open call (Royal Drawing School placement)

residencies.name: Ashkal Alwan, Home Workspace Program
residencies.provides: Monthly stipend, shared studio, free tuition
residencies.notes: No travel cover; as of 2025 restricted to artists living in Lebanon

residencies.name: Pivo (Pesquisa / Satelite)
residencies.notes: Stipend not documented; international artists have participated

residencies.name: Victoria Miro Venice Studio
residencies.notes: Invitation only, cannot apply

residencies.name: Wassaic Project
residencies.notes: $600 fee + $25 app fee; need-based aid and fellowships; open to artists anywhere

residencies.name: Tang Museum, Alfred Z. Solomon Residency
residencies.notes: Faculty-style teaching residency, not a general open call

residencies.name: MASS MoCA Studios
residencies.notes: $650/week subsidised fee; aid and full-ride fellowships by need; international eligibility

residencies.name: Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS), International Creator Residency
residencies.requirements: Visual art, film, design or architecture; stay full 3 months; no paid/commercial work during; English or Japanese
residencies.provides: Round-trip airfare, private room, shared studio, JPY 4,200/day living stipend, JPY 300,000 project fee
residencies.notes: Best funded in Japan list; only 6 creators a year, competitive; no leaving during the stay

residencies.name: Kyoto Art Center, Artist in Residence Program
residencies.requirements: Emerging artist/researcher with a clear reason to be in Kyoto; public exchange project; English or Japanese
residencies.provides: Accommodation, studio, round-trip economy airfare, JPY 200,000 production subsidy
residencies.notes: No living stipend; food and living costs are yours

residencies.name: L-AIR Himeji, Artist in Residence & Support Program
residencies.requirements: Any genre, age, nationality; must engage with leather and local artisans; share process publicly; Japanese or English
residencies.provides: Free housing, studio, materials, one-way travel reimbursement, up to $1,500/month grant
residencies.notes: Great if the practice can take leather as a material; communal living

residencies.name: Youkobo Art Space
residencies.notes: Self-funded, about JPY 190,000/month; no restrictions on field, age, nationality

residencies.name: XXO Art Residency
residencies.notes: Rural, small cohorts; no stipend advertised

residencies.name: BnA Fusion
residencies.notes: Intense cross-discipline program; funding not discussed

residencies.name: Center AiR
residencies.notes: Artist-run, all genres; funding not discussed

residencies.name: Palazzo Monti
residencies.notes: DUPLICATE of chat A entry

residencies.name: Villa Lena
residencies.provides: Room, studio, half board for ~EUR 150/week; ~EUR 21 app fee
residencies.notes: One scholarship a year waives the fee (low income, at-risk, fleeing conflict)

residencies.name: Marea Art Project
residencies.notes: No direct stipend; invitation letters for Culture Moves Europe grants (Creative Europe countries only, so not India)

residencies.name: Fondazione Pistoletto Cittadellarte, UNIDEE
residencies.provides: Sliding-scale fee (~EUR 280/module), partial travel bursaries every call; some fully funded partner residencies
residencies.notes: Social-practice focus

residencies.name: Arroscia Residency
residencies.provides: Round-trip airfare, shared housing, studio, exhibition, weekly materials/living stipend
residencies.notes: Emerging and mid-career, visual media; one work stays in collection

residencies.name: Mahler & LeWitt Studios
residencies.provides: Accommodation, studio, ~EUR 1,000/month
residencies.notes: No obligation to produce; Yale / King's College / Fendi partnerships

residencies.name: Villa Medici
residencies.provides: ~EUR 1,500/month
residencies.notes: Requires French fluency

residencies.name: Palazzo Baronale de Gualtieris / Kora Centro del Contemporaneo
residencies.notes: Mediterranean/community focus; Mondriaan Fonds and French Embassy partners

residencies.name: European Media Art Platform (EMAP) Residency 2026
residencies.requirements: European artists/collectives in digital, media, robotic, bio art
residencies.provides: EUR 4,000 artist grant + EUR 2,000 collaborator + EUR 4,000 project budget; accommodation and travel
residencies.notes: Likely Europe-only eligibility

residencies.name: Medialab Matadero, Situated Research Residencies 2027
residencies.requirements: Individuals/collectives in art, design, science, technology; link to Medialab research themes
residencies.provides: EUR 10,000 stipend
residencies.notes: Open internationally; best current bet in that chat. Chat D's first list called a similar call 'Palacio Molina', likely the same call

residencies.name: 25AV Residency Program (2026-2027)
residencies.notes: Creative Europe funded; this round CLOSED; Europe-based collaborations

residencies.name: Harvestworks T.E.A.M. Lab AIR 2026
residencies.notes: US/legal residents only; studio + engineer support, no stipend found

residencies.name: medienfrische 2026
residencies.notes: Free; all nationalities; 2026 closed (Feb)

residencies.name: Hambidge Residencies, Spring Session
residencies.notes: International; $30 app fee

residencies.name: Hayama Art Residency
residencies.provides: Airfare, private room, $800 stipend; $95 app fee
residencies.notes: Any medium, any career stage, international

residencies.name: Cite internationale des arts
residencies.provides: Via partner programs: >= EUR 1,000/month stipend, round-trip travel, studio-apartment, sometimes up to ~EUR 3,000 production grant
residencies.notes: Strongest Paris option; each partner program (AWARE, Art Explora, etc.) has its own deadline

residencies.name: Fondation Fiminco
residencies.provides: Production grants ~EUR 1,250-5,000; fabrication workshops
residencies.notes: Project money, not a living stipend; wants some production history

residencies.name: POUSH (Manifesto)
residencies.notes: Subsidised studios ~EUR 10/m2/month; ongoing community, not fixed-term

residencies.name: ACCR, Odyssee & Nora programs
residencies.provides: Free accommodation and technical resources
residencies.notes: No confirmed cash stipend

residencies.name: Villa Belleville
residencies.notes: Low-cost City of Paris studio space; no stipend found

residencies.name: Gasworks
residencies.provides: Studio, Residency House accommodation, return flights, weekly living stipend, materials budget, travel card
residencies.notes: Up to 20 a year; calls are country-specific, check for an India/South Asia call

residencies.name: Delfina Foundation
residencies.provides: Daily living allowance, materials, accommodation, return travel, visa fee reimbursement, transport
residencies.notes: Thematic calls, often nationality-restricted

residencies.name: Sarabande Foundation
residencies.provides: Studio at GBP 1/sq ft/month, utilities, mentoring
residencies.notes: UK address and right to work required, no visa sponsorship; scholarships are for CSM/Slade students

residencies.name: Cubitt Artists
residencies.notes: Subsidised studios; 18-month curatorial fellowship; relocation fight

residencies.name: SPACE Studios, Art + Technology
residencies.notes: UK-based artists; no stipend confirmed
